bullets.text: Boldyn Launches 5G at Stadium — **Boldyn Networks** installs UK's first neutral-host 5G system at Sunderland's Stadium of Light.
Free VPNs Surge Post-Act — The **Online Safety Act** drives users to risky free VPN services for privacy protection.
UK Fibre Rollout Hits 80% — Full-fibre broadband coverage in the UK approaches 80%, driven by **Openreach**'s expansion.
Full Fibre Adoption Surges — Despite a stagnant market, **full fibre** connections in the UK grow significantly.
EE Crowned Best Mobile Network — **EE** retains its title as the UK's best mobile network for the twelfth consecutive year.
BT Expands AWS Partnership — **BT Group** signs a five-year cloud partnership with **AWS** to enhance customer experiences.
Telcos Struggle with Disaggregation — Despite ambitions, telecoms face challenges in executing future-ready disaggregated networks.
